liquidity.name: Rayquaza VMAX (Alternate Art Secret)
liquidity.read: 4 sold against 33 listed — the shelf is far deeper than the demand under it. A price here is what sellers hope for, not what the market pays.
liquidity.simple: 33 of these are for sale and about 4 sold last month. More sales than listings means it moves quickly; far more listings than sales means you might wait.

gradedPremium.name: Umbreon ex - 161/131
gradedPremium.read: A PSA 10 has been selling around $5,100 against $1,491 ungraded, so a 10 clears the grading cost comfortably. A 9 sells around $1,427, which does not cover it once the fee is counted. The whole decision is the odds of getting the 10.
gradedPremium.simple: Ungraded this sells for about $1,491. Graded a 10 it sells for about $5,100, graded a 9 about $1,427. Grading costs the same either way, so the question is how likely a 10 is.
gradedPremium.basis: 550 PSA 10 sales and 561 PSA 9 sales observed
